title: MOXIM Textures
description: This textur pack change everything to the meme texture MOXIM, the gameplay will be harder with it, but funny!
body:
# Hello there!

 This texture pack will make the gameplay much harder and it was made just for fun!
 Not really recommended for survival, but it's rather good to have fun with friends!
 Every texture is the same, the texture of MOXIM!
